eventDetail.scope: This conference focuses on recent advances in Big Data and Information Security, covering both theoretical developments and practical applications. The Big Data track includes data capture and storage, scalable and distributed systems, cloud platforms, data visualization, knowledge graphs, big data management, and machine learning techniques for large-scale data processing. It also addresses tools and technologies that enable efficient development and deployment of big data solutions.  The Information Security track explores authentication, access control, cryptography, privacy and anonymity, digital forensics, network and mobile security, multimedia security, security policies and governance, hardware security, and emerging areas such as cryptocurrency and blockchain. The conference aims to provide a platform for researchers and practitioners to share innovations and address current challenges in data and security technologies.
